notes.title: Sucronomicon featured in Pixel Power Play
notes.notes:
[p]We had an amazing time at [b]Pixel Power Play[/b] during [b]Toronto Games Week[/b], showing off [i]Sucronomicon[/i] and hanging out with fellow horror and baking fans IRL! Big thanks to everyone who dropped by, played the demo, and shared your thoughts, we loved meeting you all![/p][p]Our other title, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3462910/Space_Sucks/"]Space Sucks[/url], also made an appearance, and let’s just say: the space vacuums did [i]not[/i] disappoint. 🌀[/p][p][/p][p]Missed the event? No worries, the [i]Sucronomicon[/i] demo is still live on Steam! [/p][p]Try it out, and don’t forget to wishlist [i]both[/i] of our games - it really helps us out as an indie team. 💛[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1932380/Sucronomicon/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Check other games taking part in the event here ➡️ [url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45645522-Pixel-Power-Play/sale/pixelpowerplay"]Pixel Power Play[/url]  [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for all the love,
[b]— The Red Meat Games Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Sucronomicon Joins Steam's Zombies vs Vampires Fest! 🧟‍♀️🧛‍♂️
notes.notes:
[i]The undead are rising, and the ovens are heating up! 
[/i]
We're thrilled to announce that Sucronomicon is part of Steam's [b]Zombies vs. Vampires Fest[/b].
Running from May 26 to June 2, the fest features spine-chilling discounts, free demos, and undead mayhem, and Sucronomicon is rising from the grave to join in.

Whether you’re summoning gingerbread monsters or casting frosting-based spells, there's no better time to dive into the demo and experience our candy-coated chaos.

[b]Play the Sucronomicon demo now and join the sugary side of the undead!
[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1932380/Sucronomicon/

[b]🧟‍♀️🧁 Explore the fest page here: [/b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/category/zombies_vampires]Zombies vs. Vampires Fest[/url]

If you're enjoying the taste of what's to come, don’t forget to add Sucronomicon to your wishlist - it helps us out a scary lot and ensures you won't miss any sweet updates!

Thanks for supporting indie games like ours, it means the (undead) world to us!

Yours magically,
The Sucronomicon Team

notes.title: SUCRONOMICON DEMO is OUT NOW!

notes.title: 🧁 SUCRONOMICON DEMO is coming to the table 🧁
notes.notes:
[h2]We’re excited to announce that Sucronomicon Demo is coming [b]April 18, 10 am AST! [/b][/h2]

Get ready to whip up forbidden desserts and fight against the ticking clock in our darkly-delicious baking game. 

It’s been an incredible journey bringing the game to life, and we can’t wait for you to finally get a taste. 
Huge thanks to our amazing community for the support so far. Your enthusiasm means everything! 

To celebrate, some of our awesome content creators will be livestreaming the game on [b]April 18, 8 pm EDT[/b], so be sure to tune in and check it out:
